text:
linda: Poll time — emoji diplomacy: which emoji should be banned from PR threads forever? I’ll nominate :eyes: — it immediately reads as ‘passive-aggressive review’.

sam: +1 on banning :eyes:. If i see that i assume there's a rewrite party brewing.

maya: I vote to exile :thumbsup: when it's used as ‘i glanced but did not care’. so many false approvals.

raj: My ban is :fire: on TODO comments. That emoji makes me nervous.

britt: Hands down :tada: when it's used on tiny bugfixes. celebratory energy mismatch.

sam: Also, if someone drops :100: in a code comment i will rename their var to `honest_linter_flag`.

maya: quick question — is :shrug: allowed? i'm borderline on that one. :shrug:

linda: @maya allowed only for true ambiguity. otherwise exile.

deploy-bot: Deploy status: build passing ✅ — carrying on with emoji protocol enforcement.

raj: Reaction poll: who bans which? add your emoji: :eyes: -> @linda, :thumbsup: -> @maya, :tada: -> @britt

britt: Winner by committee! :joy: Also offer: coffee (or pastries) to anyone who stops using :eyes:.

linda: @britt deal. first offender buys pastries. :crossed_fingers:

sam: note: i will use :100: ironically forever. please send pastries to my desk.
